mapper.select: /* 케어 일정 단건 조회(삭제 제외) */ SELECT SCHDL_SN , PET_SN , SCHDL_KND_CD , CLDR_BADGE_COLR_CD , SCHDL_SRC_CD , SCHDL_DT , SCHDL_NM , MEMO_CN , DEL_YN , HR_INPT_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , RGTR_ID , MDFR_ID , HSPTL_NM , CKUP_TYPE_CD FROM SCHDL WHERE SCHDL_SN = #{schdlSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: /* 일정에 연결된 투약 항목의 반려동물 변경 */ UPDATE CARE_ARTCL SET PET_SN = #{petSn} , MAIN_EXPSR_YN = 'N' , MAIN_SORT_SEQ = 0 , MDFR_ID = #{actorId} , MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE PRSC_SN IN ( SELECT P.PRSC_SN FROM PRSC P JOIN CKUP_RCD C ON C.CKUP_RCD_SN = P.CKUP_RCD_SN WHERE C.SCHDL_SN = #{schdlSn} ) OR REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN IN ( SELECT R.REPT_PRVNT_MNG_SN FROM REPT_PRVNT_MNG R JOIN CKUP_RCD C ON C.CKUP_RCD_SN = R.CKUP_RCD_SN WHERE C.SCHDL_SN = #{schdlSn} )
